scripts.clean-install: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json packages/*/node_modules && npm install && npm run db:generate
scripts.db:setup: dotenv -e .env -- npm run db:push && dotenv -e .env -- npm run db:seed
scripts.build: dotenv -e .env -- turbo run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r packages/web/dist dist
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:web" "npm run start:server"
scripts.info:railway: echo '🚂 Railway Deployment Instructions:' && echo '1. Go to https://railway.app' && echo '2. Connect your GitHub repository' && echo '3. Railway will auto-detect railway.toml configuration' && echo '4. Add PostgreSQL database' && echo '5. Deploy!' && echo '' && echo 'Configuration files:' && echo '- railway.toml (deployment config)' && echo '- .railwayignore (files to exclude)' && echo '- Dockerfile (monorepo build)'
